boundary: Official Douyin Open Platform adapter contract tests only. No developer application mutation, credential access/change, real OAuth, network call, media upload or external publication occurred.

controls: minimum video.create scope inherited from accepted OAuth profile
128 MB single-upload ceiling with fail-closed multipart handoff
published item id and share URL retained when returned

limitations: The local adapter deliberately rejects files above 128 MB until the official multipart protocol is implemented and independently qualified; preflight provides the actionable boundary.
Account-specific privacy and publishing eligibility beyond the minimum official video.create grant must be discovered during owner-approved live qualification.

required_actions: owner identifies and approves a Douyin developer app with video.create enabled
owner confirms credential addition or change for that app
owner confirms OAuth for a named Douyin account
owner separately confirms publication of a named MP4 with reviewed title and copy
live_acceptance_gate.reason: These are external authorization, credential and publication actions and were not authorized by this local milestone.
